title: ADNI 研究团队发表血浆生物标志物纵向分析结果
originalTitle: Plasma Alzheimer''s assays agree on level but much less on individual rates of change
summary: ADNI 研究团队在血浆tau217、tau181、GFAP、NfL等生物标志物的纵向分析中发现，跨时间点的个体变化检测可靠性较低（pTau217 ICC=0.44，95%CI 0.37–0.50），建议延长观察周期或增加样本量以提高检测准确性。

story.title: ADNI血浆生物标志物纵向分析显示个体变化检测可靠性不足

author: Yang, Y., Raymont, V., Rowe, J. B., Petersen, K. K., Begde, A., Brohier, R., McEwen-Smith, R., Koychev, I., Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative
